before: Some time ago, an interesting discovery was made by archaeologists on the Aegean
island of Kea. An American team explored a temple which stands in an ancient city
on the of Ayia Irini. The city at one time must have been prosperous, for it enjoyed a
high level of civilization. Houses, often three storeys high, were built of stone. They
had large rooms with beautifully decorated walls. The city was even equipped with a
drainage system, for a great many clay pipes were found beneath the narrow streets.
